query: SELECT Med_drug.prescription_status, COUNT(Med_disease.common_symptoms) AS count_Med_disease_common_symptoms FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE Med_disease.diagnostic_methods = 'genetic_testing' OR Med_disease.pathogenesis = 'traumatic' OR Med_drug.mechanism_of_action = 'PDE4 inhibitor that blocks the action of PDE4, reducing inflammation and relaxing smooth muscle in the airways' GROUP BY Med_drug.prescription_status;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.common_symptoms, Med_disease.diagnostic_methods, Med_disease.pathogenesis, Med_drug.mechanism_of_action, Med_drug.prescription_status, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name
